quote: "Three nights on the Sand River first. The Cape keeps; the leopards don't wait." — J. W.
answer: The Sand River by Road is a 9-day South Africa itinerary from James Wild & Co.: three nights at Londolozi in the western Sabi Sand (Varty Camp or Tree Camp), three at Ellerman House in Cape Town and two at Leeu Estates in Franschhoek. You go by road from Johannesburg to Londolozi, by air to Cape Town, by road to the Winelands and back to Cape Town for your flights.

days.title: Johannesburg to the Sand River
days.line: By road to Londolozi · time on request
days.body: By road from Johannesburg (OR Tambo): the N12 and N4 east to Nelspruit, the R40 through White River to Hazyview, then the R536 towards Paul Kruger Gate. About 37 km along it, a gravel road turns off to the Sabi Sand's Shaws Gate, where the reserve charges an entry fee per person and per vehicle. From the gate it is about 17 km to camp, following Londolozi's signs.

founder.title: Londolozi in 2018. The Cape in 2026.
founder.p1: James stayed at Londolozi in 2018 with his daughter and toured every room. In May 2026 he stayed at Ellerman House and visited and vetted every Leeu Estates property in Franschhoek.
founder.p2: This is the route he suggests for South Africa: three nights on the Sand River, the house standard in a safari region, then Cape Town and the Winelands, with every stay already in the Ledger.

faqs: How long is The Sand River by Road?
Nine days and eight nights: three at Londolozi in the Sabi Sand, three at Ellerman House in Cape Town and two at Leeu Estates in Franschhoek.
On the Sand River in the western Sabi Sand, unfenced to Kruger National Park. Londolozi has its own airstrip for charter flights.
How do you get from Johannesburg to Londolozi by road?

East on the N12 and N4 to Nelspruit, the R40 through White River to Hazyview, then the R536 towards Paul Kruger Gate and the gravel road to the Sabi Sand's Shaws Gate. From the gate it is about 17 km to camp. We give the driving time when we plan your dates.
Will I see leopards at Londolozi?
Londolozi reports 75 to 100 leopard sightings a month, and guests usually see two or three leopards in three nights. Wildlife keeps its own schedule, so it's a likelihood, not a promise.

Varty Camp is the original camp: ten chalets, the Healing House, a gym and the Photographic Studio, and children aged six and over are welcome. Tree Camp has six suites in the leadwood canopy and takes no children under 16 unless booked whole.
Winter, May to August, is dry and mild (3–20°C). Summer, September to April, is hot, with afternoon storms (18–36°C).
It is a low-risk malaria area. Precautions are still advised; ask your doctor before you travel.
How far is Franschhoek from Cape Town?
About 80 km, about 1 hr 20 min by road. From Leeu Estates it is about 70 km to Cape Town International (CPT), around 60 to 75 minutes depending on traffic.
How much does The Sand River by Road cost?
It is quoted against your dates and travellers, with any current offer applied. James Wild & Co does not publish a fixed price for this route.
